arguments.message: Jeanene planning: best-fit tasks by my private costs/skills are ISSUE-0001::triage (2.16), ISSUE-0001::review/docs (2.70), ISSUE-0001::test (3.78). Preference for maximizing completions/cost-efficiency: I can tentatively cover an ISSUE-0001 micro-task, especially triage/review/docs/test, and defer ISSUE-0002 to stronger-fit agents if available. Please share intended claims to avoid duplicates.
